# OntoLink project instructions

Before project work, read [skills/ontolink-skills/.rule/ONTOLOGY-FIRST.md](../skills/ontolink-skills/.rule/ONTOLOGY-FIRST.md).
Resolve the installed `ontolink-skills` coordinator and run the policy's `start`
command first. Keep generated records and text in the fixed `.ontolink/` directory.

For this distribution checkout, run:

```sh
python skills/ontolink-skills/.rule/ontolink.py start --root . --skill-root skills/ontolink-skills
```
